memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, epilepsy, and gout are stable.
Patient reports good seizure control on levetiracetam and lamotrigine, no recent gout flares, and attempts at dietary weight management. Examination shows BMI 32 kg/m2, waist circumference 108 cm, blood pressure 138/86 mmHg, lungs clear, no joint tenderness or swelling. Smoking status: former, quit 2010, pack-years 20.

memories.text: I have been taking my medicines as prescribed. My weight is around 92 kg. I have not had any seizures in the past month. My big toe felt a bit sore last week but it resolved without colchicine.

Patient reports weight 93 kg, BMI 31.8, waist 106 cm, no seizures, no gout flares. Exam: lungs clear, cardiovascular normal, joints non‑tender. Smoking status: former, quit 2010, pack-years 20. Spirometry not performed as no obstructive airway disease.
